title: skill.meta.json
description: The metadata of one skill folder, skills/<family>/<slug>/skill.meta.json. scripts/validate-skills.js checks every meta against this schema, then adds the rules a schema cannot say (the slug matches the folder, the version matches SKILL.md, the family's domain and install command). build-index.js copies the whole object into skills-index.json as `metadata`, so a new field is published as it is: add it here first.

slug.description: The folder name. Permanent: recipes, the app and installed copies use it.

category.description: Abstraction level. The app syncs only these three; anything else is retired.

version.description: Semver. Raise it on every change: entry skills and installed copies update by it, and recipes pin video atoms by it (scripts/check-atom-versions.js).

domain.description: Catalog area. Video skills default to ads, marketing skills to marketing-agent, entry skills to gooseworks; a shared skill must name one. marketing-agent and gooseworks belong to their families only.

tags.description: Catalog filters. Marketing skills need at least one.

requires_skills.description: Every other skill this one reads or runs, by slug. Installers deliver them next to it as ../<slug>/.

requires_tools.description: Programs the user's machine must already have (ffmpeg, python…). Never files: a skill ships its own helpers inside its folder.

features.description: Short selling points shown on the catalog page.

example_prompt.description: One thing a user might say to start it.

lint_allow.description: Atom lint findings that are creative content, not instructions (scripts/atom-lint.js).

tier.description: Marketing skills: playbook, atom (a step) or foundation. Entry skills: entry.

playbook.description: Marketing steps: the playbook that runs this step.

standalone.description: Marketing steps: true when the step also works on its own.

used_by.description: Marketing shared steps: the playbooks that run it.

pillar.description: Marketing playbooks: the marketing pillar it covers.

intents.description: Marketing playbooks: things a marketer says that should start it (the evals route on them).

reads.description: Marketing playbooks: what it reads, and who writes it.

writes.description: Marketing playbooks: what it writes, and who reads it.

needs.description: Marketing playbooks: what must be connected.

source_commit.description: Published from goose-studio: the source commit.

source_hash.description: Published from goose-studio: SHA-256 of the source skill.

source_version.description: Published from goose-studio: the source version label.
